title: Fit MAS model to 77 K neutron data and elastic constants
action: Implement the MAS model force-constant expressions and dynamical matrix for hcp crystals (following DeWames et al. and Warren). Load the 77 K neutron data (provided as input tables) and the experimental elastic constants. Perform nonlinear least-squares fitting to obtain model 1A parameters. Output the fitted force constants and χ² as a CSV file.
description: Fitted force-constant parameters of the preferred 77 K MAS model (model 1A) that simultaneously fits the neutron data and the elastic constants.
output_schema: Table with columns: parameter_name, value. Rows for K1, epsilon_1x, alpha_2, beta_2x, K3, epsilon_3x, alpha_4, beta_4x, K5, epsilon_5x, alpha_6, beta_6x, sigma_B, chi_squared. Value units: dyn/cm for force constants, dimensionless for sigma_B and chi_squared.

title: Fit MAS model to 296 K neutron data and elastic constants
action: Using the same MAS model implementation, load the 296 K neutron data (provided as input tables) and experimental elastic constants, and fit to obtain model 1B parameters. Output the fitted force constants and χ² as a CSV file.
description: Fitted force-constant parameters of the preferred 296 K MAS model (model 1B) that simultaneously fits the neutron data and the elastic constants.
output_schema: Same as fitted_params_77K.csv: columns parameter_name, value. Value units: dyn/cm for force constants, dimensionless for sigma_B and chi_squared.

title: Compute phonon density of states at 77 K from fitted model
action: Using the fitted parameters from step 'step_fit_77k', compute the phonon density of states F(ω) on a fine frequency grid (0–12 meV) for the 77 K model. Save the DOS curve as a CSV file.
description: Phonon density of states at 77 K, produced from the fitted model 1A.
output_schema: Two columns: frequency (meV) and dos (arbitrary units).

title: Compute phonon density of states at 296 K from fitted model
action: Using the fitted parameters from step 'step_fit_296k', compute the phonon density of states F(ω) on a fine frequency grid (0–12 meV) for the 296 K model. Save the DOS curve as a CSV file.
description: Phonon density of states at 296 K, produced from the fitted model 1B.
output_schema: Two columns: frequency (meV) and dos (arbitrary units).

title: Compute phonon frequencies at high-symmetry points
action: Using the fitted parameters from both 77 K and 296 K models, compute the phonon frequencies at the high-symmetry points Γ, M, A, L, H, K. Save all frequencies in a CSV file.
description: Phonon frequencies at the high-symmetry points Γ, M, A, L, H, K for both 77 K and 296 K models.

title: Extract and report key numerical results
action: From the computed DOS curves, extract the peak positions (local maxima) and the highest frequency (cutoff). Compile the fitted χ² values and report all quantities in a JSON file.
description: Summary of the main results: DOS peak positions, cutoff frequencies, and goodness-of-fit values.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: dos_77K_peaks (list of floats, meV), dos_77K_cutoff (float, meV), dos_296K_peaks (list of floats, meV), dos_296K_cutoff (float, meV), chi_squared_77K (float), chi_squared_296K (float).
